title: Koala with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='fur' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c8d4e0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fa3b8'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='ear' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b8c6d6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7f93a8'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='34' r='15' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='34' r='15' fill='#8fa3b8'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='34' r='9' fill='#e3ecf5'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='34' r='9' fill='#e3ecf5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='28' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#dfe8f1'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#3f4a5a'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='58' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5a6880'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 68 Q50 72 56 68' stroke='#5a6880' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='46' r='6' fill='#2e3648'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='46' r='6' fill='#2e3648'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='1.1' fill='#bfe0ff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='48' r='1.1' fill='#bfe0ff'/>
  <!-- sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M30 36 l1.2 2.6 2.6 1.2 -2.6 1.2 -1.2 2.6 -1.2 -2.6 -2.6 -1.2 2.6 -1.2 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M70 38 l1 2.2 2.2 1 -2.2 1 -1 2.2 -1 -2.2 -2.2 -1 2.2 -1 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M50 30 l0.9 2 2 0.9 -2 0.9 -0.9 2 -0.9 -2 -2 -0.9 2 -0.9 z' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
